steps.name: Land-first six-stage workflow does not request device location
OSM remains idle until the explicit consent is set, and a tile outage leaves local editing available
Draw, edit and measure a real four-corner WGS84 polygon with true-north bearings
Save/import/reopen restores the exact editable polygon, confirmed measurements, view and binding
Clear confirmation removes only the saved survey and preserves generator dimensions
Phone and iPad-sized viewports reach the map editor without horizontal overflow

limitations: OSM requests intentionally returned HTTP 503 to verify offline fallback
Viewport simulations used Chromium; no physical iPad tested
No official parcel data source is configured
